name: Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce
author: unagui

sections.description:
Unagui Save Cart is a lightweight plugin for WooCommerce that allows your logged-in customers to save their current cart contents and restore them later.

This is perfect for customers who want to build a cart on one device and checkout on another, or simply save a selection of products for a future purchase.

Features:
* Save Cart Widget: A customizable form (Title, Placeholder, Button Text) that can be placed via Shortcode or automatically injected.
* My Account Integration: Adds a “My Saved Carts” tab to the WooCommerce My Account area.
* View & Restore: Users can view the contents of saved carts in a popup and restore them with a single click.
* Bulk Actions: Delete multiple saved carts at once.

Free vs Pro:
The free version allows saving carts for personal use. The Pro version adds sharing capabilities (via link) and email changes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/unagui-save-cart directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings link or go to Unagui Plugins > Save Cart to configure the widget text.
  4. The “Save Cart” form will automatically appear on the Cart page (if enabled).
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is an extension for WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and active.

Can guest users save carts?

No, users must be logged in to save a cart to their account.
